name: Steam & Clicks
detailed_description:
In a collapsing steampunk world, take control of Rose Mary, a brilliant mechanic who must defend her city from a recent undead invasion led by a bitter villain. With the help of the factory and workshop she inherited from her father, she’ll be able to craft a wide array of weapons, equipment, and most importantly, powerful battle armors!

⛏️CRAFT

Click to produce various resources and bring your arsenal to life. Each producer has a specific purpose and is directly tied to certain items.

⚙️UPGRADE

Invest in upgrades to supercharge your machines. Automate, increase output, and unlock synergies between producers to maximize your efficiency.

🔧EVOLVE

Upgrade your gear and unlock unique special effects. Each evolution boosts your stats and opens up new strategic possibilities.

🧠PLAN

Choose your battle armor and prepare your weapons. Unlock, manage, and analyze your workshop options to create powerful combos during fights.

💥FIGHT

Face hordes of zombies in turn-based battles! Progress through the map, take down increasingly tough enemies, and reach the villain’s castle at the heart of the chaos.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Win 7 or above
  • Processor: 1.66 GHz Dual Core Processor or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA since 2006 (GeForce 8), AMD since 2006 (Radeon HD 2000), Intel since 2012 (HD 4000 / IvyBridge)
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
